bounty.title: Add Skill: Tereno (Base Pre-Action Security Cache & x402 Cooperative Verification)
bounty.body:
## Skill Info

    - **Name:** tereno
    - **GitHub URL:** https://github.com/tereno-xyz/skills
    - **Category:** ai-crypto
    - **Official?** Yes

    ## Description

    Pre-action onchain security cache, live `eth_call` exit simulation, deployer
    cabal/Sybil detection, and UMA oracle dispute auditing for autonomous agents on Base
    (`eip155:8453`) via x402 USDC and MCP. Supports Binance Agentic Wallet (`baw`),
    OpenClaw, ERC-8183 escrow arbitration, ERC-7579 smart account guard proofs, and a
    cooperative dividend economy (+$0.005 seeding bounties and 20% reuse credits).

    ## Install Command (if applicable)

    ```bash
    npx skills add tereno-xyz/skills
    # or via OpenClaw:
    openclaw skills install tereno
    # or via Claude MCP:
    claude mcp add tereno https://www.tereno.xyz/api/mcp

  ## Checklist

  [✓] Repo contains a SKILL.md with name and description
  [✓] No hardcoded API keys or private keys in the code
  [✓] Open source or publicly accessible
